'''Bormus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbited by a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]-run naval [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|testing facility]].

==Characteristics==
Bormus was covered in a luminescent glow eminating from the thick clouds that obscured much of the planet, while gas radiated outwards.

==History==
During the campaign against the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], Senator [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] had oversight of the facility, where new [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] were undergoing testing before deployment in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
He refused to hand them over to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for use against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], which led to Skywalker taking his [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron's]] pilots to the system and getting them personally.
